title.zh: 卷346 列傳一百三十三 恒瑞 庆成 七十五 富志那 亮禄
title.en: Volume 346 Biographies 133: Heng Rui, Qing Cheng, Qi Shi Wu, Fu Zhina, Liang Lu
title.raw: 卷346 列傳一百三十三 恒瑞 庆成 七十五 富志那 亮禄

sentences.zh: 恆瑞，宗室，隸正白旗，吉林將軍薩喇善子。

translations.literal: Heng Rui was of the imperial clan, enrolled in the Plain White Banner, and was the son of Sala Shan, General of Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: Heng Rui belonged to the imperial clan and was registered in the Plain White Banner; he was the son of Sala Shan, the general of Jilin.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中，授侍衛，赴西藏辦事，擢熱河都統，遷福州將軍。

translations.literal: During the Qianlong reign he was appointed a bodyguard, was sent on duties to Tibet, was promoted to commander-in-chief at Rehe, and was transferred to be general at Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianlong he became an imperial guardsman, served on affairs in Tibet, rose to commander-in-chief at Rehe, and was later appointed general at Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 五十二年，台灣林爽文作亂，命率駐防兵往剿，參贊軍務，偕總督常青赴南路。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year [of Qianlong], when Lin Shuangwen rebelled in Taiwan, he was ordered to lead the garrison troops to suppress the rebellion, to assist in military affairs, and to go with Governor-General Changqing to the southern route.
translations.idiomatic: In 1787, when Lin Shuangwen rose in Taiwan, he was ordered to lead garrison forces against the rebels, appointed to assist in the campaign, and marched with Governor-General Changqing along the southern front.

sentences.zh: 鳳山賊勢方熾，高宗知常青、恆瑞不可恃，命福康安督師。

translations.literal: The rebels' strength at Fengshan was then at its height; the Gaozong Emperor knew that Changqing and Heng Rui could not be relied upon, and ordered Fuk'anggan to take command of the army.
translations.idiomatic: With rebel power blazing at Fengshan, the Qianlong Emperor concluded that Changqing and Heng Rui were not to be trusted, and put Fuk'anggan in overall command.

sentences.zh: 賊圍總兵柴大紀於諸羅，恆瑞駐軍鹽水港，逗留不進，詔解任。

translations.literal: The rebels besieged Brigadier Chai Daji at Zhuluo; Heng Rui encamped at Yanshui Harbor and lingered without advancing, and an edict removed him from office.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels besieged Brigadier Chai Daji at Zhuluo, Heng Rui held his force at Yanshui Harbor and stalled; the court dismissed him from his post.

sentences.zh: 福康安至，屢為疏陳戰績，帝益怒，斥其徇護，逮恆瑞論罪。

translations.literal: When Fuk'anggan arrived, [Heng Rui] repeatedly memorialized reporting battle achievements; the Emperor grew still angrier, rebuked him for partiality in shielding [him], and arrested Heng Rui to be tried for his crimes.
translations.idiomatic: After Fuk'anggan arrived, Heng Rui kept sending memorials trumpeting his victories; the emperor's anger only deepened, he was accused of covering for him, and Heng Rui was arrested to stand trial.

sentences.zh: 事平，減死戍伊犁。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, his death sentence was commuted and he was banished to garrison duty at Ili.
translations.idiomatic: Once the rebellion was over, his death sentence was reduced and he was sent into exile garrison service at Ili.

sentences.zh: 尋予副都統銜，充伊犁參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was given the rank of deputy lieutenant-general and appointed Ili Assistant Grand Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he received the rank of deputy lieutenant-general and served as assistant grand minister at Ili.

sentences.zh: 歷定邊左副將軍、綏遠城將軍，調西安。

translations.literal: He successively held the posts of Left Deputy General of the Pacification of the Frontier, General of Suiyuan City, and was transferred to Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: He later served as Left Deputy General on the frontier, as general at Suiyuan, and was then transferred to Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，命率駐防兵三千，偕都統永保會剿湖北教匪。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he was ordered to lead three thousand garrison troops and, together with Commander-in-Chief Yongbao, to join in suppressing the sectarian rebels in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: In 1796 he was ordered to lead three thousand garrison troops and, with Commander-in-Chief Yongbao, to help suppress the White Lotus rebels in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 三月，與總兵文圖破賊竹山。

translations.literal: In the third month, together with Brigadier Wentu he defeated the rebels at Zhushan.
translations.idiomatic: In spring he and Brigadier Wentu routed the rebels at Zhushan.

sentences.zh: 永保至，合師由房縣進剿，文圖分剿三里坪、喇叭洞諸賊悉盡；

translations.literal: When Yongbao arrived, the combined armies advanced from Fang County to suppress the rebels; Wentu separately attacked and wiped out the rebels at Sanliping, Labadong, and other places;
translations.idiomatic: When Yongbao arrived, their united forces pushed from Fang County; Wentu meanwhile cleared out the rebel bands at Sanliping, Labadong, and elsewhere;

sentences.zh: 而恆瑞追賊至保康，未大創之。

translations.literal: but Heng Rui pursued the rebels only as far as Baokang and did not inflict a major defeat on them.
translations.idiomatic: while Heng Rui chased the rebels only to Baokang and failed to deal them a serious blow.

sentences.zh: 賊首姚之富踞襄陽，勢甚熾，命恆瑞進剿。

translations.literal: The rebel leader Yao Zhifu held Xiangyang and his power was very strong; Heng Rui was ordered to advance and suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel chief Yao Zhifu held Xiangyang in great strength, and Heng Rui was ordered to move against him.

sentences.zh: 五月，偕明亮進次呂堰，擊賊岳家溝、劉家集，擒斬二千餘。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, together with Mingliang he advanced and encamped at Lüyan, attacked the rebels at Yuejiagou and Liujiaji, and captured or killed more than two thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In summer he joined Mingliang at Lüyan, struck the rebels at Yuejiagou and Liujiaji, and killed or captured more than two thousand men.

sentences.zh: 賊圍棗陽，設伏王家岡，誘賊敗之；

translations.literal: The rebels besieged Zaoyang; he set an ambush at Wangjiagang and lured the rebels into defeat;
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels besieged Zaoyang, he laid an ambush at Wangjiagang, drew them in, and routed them;

sentences.zh: 又敗之於蔣家垱、曲家灣，棗陽圍解。

translations.literal: he again defeated them at Jiangjiadang and Qujiawan, and the siege of Zaoyang was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: then defeated them again at Jiangjiadang and Qujiawan, lifting the siege of Zaoyang.

sentences.zh: 賊偽降，潛襲官軍後路；

translations.literal: The rebels feigned surrender and secretly attacked the government army's rear;
translations.idiomatic: The rebels pretended to surrender and then struck at the army's rear;

sentences.zh: 急以後隊為前隊，擊退之。

translations.literal: he urgently turned the rear ranks into the front ranks and drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: he quickly swung his rear guard forward and beat them off.

sentences.zh: 賊走丫兒山，與張家垱賊相犄角，奮擊一晝夜，破賊營十餘，殲賊甚眾，被獎賚。

translations.literal: The rebels fled to Ya'er Mountain and, in mutual support with the rebels at Zhangjiadang, fought fiercely for a day and a night; more than ten rebel camps were broken, very many rebels were annihilated, and he received rewards.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels retreated to Ya'er Mountain and linked up with those at Zhangjiadang; after a full day and night of hard fighting he overran more than ten camps and killed a great many rebels, earning imperial rewards.

sentences.zh: 七月，破賊隨州龍門山，與永保會攻鍾祥賊巢，連破之鄧家河、黑沙河、雙溝。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he defeated the rebels at Longmen Mountain in Suizhou, joined Yongbao in attacking the rebel nest at Zhongxiang, and in succession broke them at Dengjiahe, Heishahe, and Shuanggou.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn he routed the rebels at Longmen Mountain in Suizhou, then with Yongbao stormed the rebel stronghold at Zhongxiang and took Dengjiahe, Heishahe, and Shuanggou in turn.

sentences.zh: 賊乃分竄唐縣、呂堰，追至滹沱鎮，复竄倉台。

translations.literal: The rebels then split and fled into Tang County and Lüyan; pursued to Hutuo Town, they again fled to Cangtai.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels then scattered toward Tang County and Lüyan; pursued to Hutuo Town, they slipped away again toward Cangtai.

sentences.zh: 尋，之富渡滾河，圍景安於鄧州。

translations.literal: Before long Zhifu crossed the Gun River and besieged Jing'an at Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Zhifu crossed the Gun River and besieged Jing'an at Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 詔斥諸將玩誤，逮永保，責恆瑞戴罪立功。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked the generals for negligence and delay; Yongbao was arrested, and Heng Rui was charged to redeem his guilt through merit.
translations.idiomatic: An edict rebuked the commanders for dallying; Yongbao was arrested, and Heng Rui was ordered to win back his honor on the battlefield.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，偕惠齡等剿襄陽賊，賊首劉起榮就擒；

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year [of Jiaqing], together with Huiling and others he suppressed the rebels at Xiangyang, and the rebel leader Liu Qirong was captured;
translations.idiomatic: In early 1797 he joined Huiling and others against the Xiangyang rebels, and rebel chief Liu Qirong was taken;

sentences.zh: 又與慶成敗賊鄭家河​​，擒賊目李潮；

translations.literal: he also, with Qing Cheng, defeated the rebels at Zhengjiahe and captured the rebel officer Li Chao;
translations.idiomatic: he and Qing Cheng also routed the rebels at Zhengjiahe and captured the rebel officer Li Chao;

sentences.zh: 進剿泰山寺、龍鳳溝，擒賊目姚爽等：賜花翎。

translations.literal: advancing to suppress the rebels at Taishan Temple and Longfenggou, he captured the rebel officers Yao Shuang and others: he was granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: then pressed the rebels at Taishan Temple and Longfenggou and captured officers such as Yao Shuang, for which he received the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 於是賊分竄，由河南入陝，恆瑞追賊至山陽，遇王廷詔、李全等，擊走之。

translations.literal: Thereupon the rebels split and fled, entering Shaanxi from Henan; Heng Rui pursued the rebels to Shanyang, encountered Wang Tingzhao, Li Quan, and others, and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels then scattered into Shaanxi from Henan; Heng Rui pursued them to Shanyang, met Wang Tingzhao, Li Quan, and their bands, and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 五月，追賊陝南，與惠齡夾攻於黃龍垱，殲賊三千餘。

translations.literal: In the fifth month he pursued the rebels in southern Shaanxi and, with Huiling attacking from both sides at Huanglongdang, annihilated more than three thousand rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In summer he chased the rebels through southern Shaanxi; at Huanglongdang he and Huiling caught them in a pincer and killed more than three thousand.

sentences.zh: 廷詔、全復與賊之富合趨紫陽，渡漢江，恆瑞坐縱賊，奪花翎。

translations.literal: Tingzhao and Quan again joined with the rebel Zhifu and rushed toward Ziyang, crossed the Han River; Heng Rui was held responsible for letting the rebels escape, and his peacock feather was taken away.
translations.idiomatic: Tingzhao and Quan rejoined Zhifu and made for Ziyang, crossing the Han; Heng Rui was blamed for letting them get away and stripped of his peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 賊遂分路入川，廷詔竄開縣、雲陽、萬縣，犯夔州，西與大寧賊響應，恆瑞追及，連敗之，乃竄太平。

translations.literal: The rebels then split into routes and entered Sichuan; Tingzhao fled through Kai County, Yunyang, and Wan County, attacked Kuizhou, and in the west coordinated with the rebels of Daning; Heng Rui caught up, repeatedly defeated them, and they then fled to Taiping.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels then split into Sichuan; Tingzhao swept through Kai, Yunyang, and Wan counties, struck at Kuizhou, and linked up with rebels in Daning to the west; Heng Rui overtook them, defeated them repeatedly, and drove them toward Taiping.

sentences.zh: 八月，當陽逸匪掠白河、洵陽，命馳赴興安扼剿，偕慶成擊賊於張家灘，由牛氾嶺繞出賊前，奪賊營九。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, fugitive rebels from Dangyang plundered Baihe and Xunyang; he was ordered to hurry to Xing'an to block and suppress them; together with Qing Cheng he attacked the rebels at Zhangjiatan, went around in front of the rebels by way of Niufan Ridge, and seized nine rebel camps.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn fugitives from Dangyang raided Baihe and Xunyang; he was ordered to Xing'an to cut them off; with Qing Cheng he struck at Zhangjiatan, swung around Niufan Ridge ahead of the rebels, and took nine camps.

sentences.zh: 廷詔等奔紫陽，與惠齡夾擊敗之。

translations.literal: Tingzhao and others fled to Ziyang and were defeated in a pincer attack with Huiling.
translations.idiomatic: Tingzhao and his band fled to Ziyang, where Huiling joined in a pincer and routed them.

sentences.zh: 恆瑞率師還漢中，敗賊西鄉，又敗之褒城黃沙鋪。

translations.literal: Heng Rui led his army back to Hanzhong, defeated the rebels at Xixiang, and again defeated them at Huangshapu in Bao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Heng Rui brought his force back to Hanzhong, beat the rebels at Xixiang, and again at Huangshapu in Bao.

sentences.zh: 十一月，之富等西奔，將渡漢北竄。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Zhifu and others fled west and were about to cross north of the Han to escape.
translations.idiomatic: In winter Zhifu and his followers fled west, preparing to cross north of the Han and break away.

sentences.zh: 偕慶成蹙諸半渡，賊西趨寧、沔。

translations.literal: Together with Qing Cheng he pressed them while they were half across [the river]; the rebels turned west toward Ning and Mian.
translations.idiomatic: With Qing Cheng he caught them mid-crossing; the rebels veered west toward Ning and Mian.

sentences.zh: 師進，遇高均德於桑樹灣，乃議四面設伏，恆瑞令撒拉爾回兵假鄉勇旗幟誘之，自由山梁馳下，慶成等分路夾擊，俘斬甚眾。

translations.literal: The army advanced and encountered Gao Junde at Sangshuwan; they then planned ambushes on four sides; Heng Rui ordered Salar Muslim troops to pose as local militia with their banners to lure the enemy, charged down from the mountain ridge, while Qing Cheng and others attacked from separate routes in a pincer; very many were captured or killed.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing, they met Gao Junde at Sangshuwan and laid a four-sided ambush; Heng Rui sent Salar Muslim troops disguised as local militia to draw the enemy in, then charged down the ridge while Qing Cheng and others struck from several directions; a great many were killed or captured.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，被優賚。

translations.literal: When news of the victory arrived, he received special rewards.
translations.idiomatic: News of the victory brought him exceptional rewards.

sentences.zh: 十二月，破王廷詔於保寧，進解營山圍。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he defeated Wang Tingzhao at Baoning and advanced to lift the siege of Yingshan.
translations.idiomatic: At year's end he routed Wang Tingzhao at Baoning and marched to relieve the siege of Yingshan.

sentences.zh: 三年，川匪羅其清犯順慶，偕慶成往援，因賊勢蔓延，請勒保、宜綿遣兵會剿。

translations.literal: In the third year [of Jiaqing], the Sichuan rebel Luo Qiqing attacked Shunqing; [Heng Rui] went with Qing Cheng to relieve them; because the rebel power was spreading, he requested that Lebao and Yimian send troops for a joint suppression.
translations.idiomatic: In 1798 the Sichuan rebel Luo Qiqing struck at Shunqing; Heng Rui went with Qing Cheng to help, and as the rebels spread he asked Lebao and Yimian to send forces for a joint campaign.

sentences.zh: 賊竄蓬州，潛結冉文儔擾儀隴，恆瑞扼磨盤寨，與惠齡等合擊之，文儔敗走，陝匪龍紹週與合，敗之楊家寨。

translations.literal: The rebels fled to Pengzhou and secretly joined with Ran Wenchou to harass Yilong; Heng Rui held Mopanzhai, joined Huiling and others in attacking them, Wenchou was defeated and fled, the Shaanxi rebel Long Shaozhou joined with him, and [they] were defeated at Yangjiazhai.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels slipped into Pengzhou and secretly linked with Ran Wenchou to raid Yilong; Heng Rui held Mopanzhai and, with Huiling and others, routed Wenchou; when the Shaanxi rebel Long Shaozhou joined him, they were beaten at Yangjiazhai.

sentences.zh: 六月，與德楞泰夾擊高均德於石人河，复偕惠齡攻老林場賊卡，進逼大神山，均德、文儔踞險死拒，分路進攻，賊奔箕山；

translations.literal: In the sixth month, together with Delengtai he attacked Gao Junde at Shirenhe in a pincer; he again joined Huiling in attacking the rebel stockades at Laolinchang, advanced and pressed Dashen Mountain; Junde and Wenchou held the dangerous ground and resisted to the death; attacking by separate routes, the rebels fled to Jishan;
translations.idiomatic: In summer he and Delengtai caught Gao Junde at Shirenhe in a pincer; with Huiling he stormed the rebel posts at Laolinchang and pressed Dashen Mountain; Junde and Wenchou held the heights and fought desperately; attacking from several sides, they drove the rebels toward Jishan;

sentences.zh: 而徐天德、樊人傑為將軍富成追擊，窮蹙，亦入焉。

translations.literal: while Xu Tiande and Fan Renjie, pursued and cornered by General Fucheng, also entered there.
translations.idiomatic: while Xu Tiande and Fan Renjie, harried and cornered by General Fucheng, fled in as well.

sentences.zh: 惠齡、德楞泰攻其前，恆瑞攻其後，盡破山寨，先後斬馘近萬。

translations.literal: Huiling and Delengtai attacked from the front, Heng Rui from the rear; all the mountain stockades were broken, and in succession nearly ten thousand were killed or captured.
translations.idiomatic: Huiling and Delengtai struck from the front while Heng Rui hit from behind; every stockade fell, and nearly ten thousand rebels were killed or taken in all.

sentences.zh: 其清，李全、王廷詔奔大鵬山，進圍，十一月，克之。

translations.literal: Qiqing, Li Quan, and Wang Tingzhao fled to Dapeng Mountain; [the army] advanced and besieged it; in the eleventh month it was taken.
translations.idiomatic: Qiqing, Li Quan, and Wang Tingzhao fled to Dapeng Mountain; the army invested it and, in winter, took it.

sentences.zh: 命赴陝與宜綿等會剿張漢潮。

translations.literal: He was ordered to go to Shaanxi and join Yimian and others in suppressing Zhang Hanchao.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to Shaanxi to join Yimian and others against Zhang Hanchao.

sentences.zh: 未幾，李全、樊人傑竄西鄉。

translations.literal: Before long Li Quan and Fan Renjie fled into Xixiang.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Li Quan and Fan Renjie broke into Xixiang.

sentences.zh: 帝以恆瑞未迎擊，嚴斥之。

translations.literal: Because Heng Rui had not met and attacked them, the Emperor sternly rebuked him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sharply rebuked him for failing to intercept them.

sentences.zh: 四年，署陝甘總督，赴寧羌擊藍、白兩號賊。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he served as acting Governor-General of Shaanxi-Gansu, went to Ningqiang to attack the Blue- and White-Banner rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In 1799 he acted as governor-general of Shaanxi-Gansu and went to Ningqiang to fight the Blue and White rebel bands.

sentences.zh: 張應祥等竄秦州、兩當，又擊走張漢潮、冉學勝股匪。

translations.literal: Zhang Yingxiang and others fled into Qinzhou and Liangdang; he again drove off the bands of Zhang Hanchao and Ran Xuesheng.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yingxiang and others slipped into Qinzhou and Liangdang; he also drove back the bands of Zhang Hanchao and Ran Xuesheng.

sentences.zh: 五月，解署任，剿白號賊於白馬關，地與川西龍安接壤，遣將冒雨掩擊，賊竄西和、禮縣；

translations.literal: In the fifth month he was relieved of his acting post and suppressed the White-Banner rebels at Baimaguan, a place bordering Long'an in western Sichuan; he sent generals to strike in a surprise attack through the rain, and the rebels fled to Xihe and Li County;
translations.idiomatic: In summer he left the acting governorship and fought the White-Banner rebels at Baimaguan on the border with Long'an in western Sichuan; he sent officers in a rainy night attack, and the rebels fled toward Xihe and Li;

sentences.zh: 令布政使廣厚、總兵吉蘭泰截剿，自趨賈家店、黑馬關抄擊藍號賊，敗之於老柏樹，复花翎。

translations.literal: he ordered the provincial treasurer Guanghou and Brigadier Jilantai to intercept and suppress them; he himself hastened to Jiajiadian and Heimaguan to strike the Blue-Banner rebels from the rear, defeated them at Laobaishu, and regained the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: he set Provincial Treasurer Guanghou and Brigadier Jilantai to cut them off while he himself swept toward Jiajiadian and Heimaguan to hit the Blue-Banner rebels from behind, routed them at Laobaishu, and won back his peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 賊竄川北，至秋，折回陝境，擊走之。

translations.literal: The rebels fled into northern Sichuan; by autumn they turned back into Shaanxi territory and were driven off.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled into northern Sichuan; in autumn they doubled back into Shaanxi and were driven out.

sentences.zh: 乃赴城固、洋縣，會明亮剿張漢潮，破之東西叉河，賊從馬埡道遁老林，要之於清水溝，复乘霧雨徐渡三渡水。

translations.literal: He then went to Chenggu and Yang County, joined Mingliang in suppressing Zhang Hanchao, defeated him at Dongxichahe; the rebels escaped along the Mayada route into the deep forests; [they] intercepted them at Qingshuigou and again, taking advantage of fog and rain, slowly crossed the Sandu River.
translations.idiomatic: He then went to Chenggu and Yang, joined Mingliang against Zhang Hanchao, and routed him at Dongxichahe; the rebels fled along the Mayada trail into the deep woods; they blocked them at Qingshuigou and, using fog and rain as cover, crossed the Sandu River at leisure.

sentences.zh: 帝疑諸將縱賊，又以恆瑞前剿藍號賊垂盡，舍之回陝，下尚書那彥成察劾。

translations.literal: The Emperor suspected the generals of letting the rebels escape; moreover, because Heng Rui had earlier nearly wiped out the Blue-Banner rebels but then abandoned them and returned to Shaanxi, he ordered the Minister Nayancheng to investigate and impeach.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor suspected his commanders of letting the rebels slip away; he also questioned why Heng Rui, who had nearly destroyed the Blue-Banner rebels, had left them and returned to Shaanxi, and ordered Minister Nayancheng to investigate.

sentences.zh: 那彥成，恆瑞之婿也，覆陳回師出總督松筠意，得免罪。

translations.literal: Nayancheng was Heng Rui's son-in-law; he reported back that the withdrawal had been at the direction of Governor-General Songyun, and [Heng Rui] was spared punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Nayancheng was Heng Rui's son-in-law; he reported that the withdrawal had been ordered by Governor-General Songyun, and Heng Rui escaped punishment.

sentences.zh: 尋明亮殲漢潮，恆瑞自五郎追擊，餘黨李得士等由大建溝入老林，趨秦嶺，與那彥成會剿冉學勝等，賊奔澇谷；

translations.literal: Before long Mingliang annihilated Hanchao; Heng Rui pursued from Wulang; the remnant band of Li Deshi and others entered the deep forests by Dajiangou and headed for the Qinling range; joining Nayancheng he jointly suppressed Ran Xuesheng and others; the rebels fled to Laogu;
translations.idiomatic: Soon Mingliang destroyed Hanchao; Heng Rui pursued from Wulang; remnants led by Li Deshi entered the deep woods through Dajiangou and made for the Qinling; with Nayancheng he moved against Ran Xuesheng and others; the rebels fled to Laogu;

sentences.zh: 扼兩岔河，追擊於山陽東溝，敗之。

translations.literal: he blocked them at Liangchahe, pursued and attacked at Donggou in Shanyang, and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: he blocked them at Liangchahe, chased them to Donggou in Shanyang, and routed them.

sentences.zh: 五年，川匪二萬餘由略陽寇兩當、徽縣，恆瑞自褒城入棧，賊竄隴州、清水、秦安，偕那彥成追至汪家山，大敗之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year more than twenty thousand Sichuan rebels from Lüeyang raided Liangdang and Hui County; Heng Rui entered the plank road from Bao Prefecture; the rebels fled to Longzhou, Qingshui, and Qin'an; together with Nayancheng he pursued to Wangjiashan and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In 1800 more than twenty thousand Sichuan rebels from Lüeyang struck Liangdang and Hui; Heng Rui entered the plank roads from Bao; the rebels fled through Longzhou, Qingshui, and Qin'an; with Nayancheng he overtook them at Wangjiashan and crushed them.

sentences.zh: 總兵凝德戰歿秦安，恆瑞赴援，复偕那彥成敗賊於龍泉溝、深都堡，總兵多爾濟、札普戰歿洵陽。

translations.literal: Brigadier Ningde was killed in battle at Qin'an; Heng Rui went to relieve him; again with Nayancheng he defeated the rebels at Longquangou and Shendubao; Brigadiers Duo'erji and Zhapu were killed in battle at Xunyang.
translations.idiomatic: Brigadier Ningde fell at Qin'an; Heng Rui hurried to help; with Nayancheng he again beat the rebels at Longquangou and Shendubao; Brigadiers Duo'erji and Zhapu died fighting at Xunyang.

sentences.zh: 詔促恆瑞赴鎮安、五郎勦賊，三月，抵唐藏。

translations.literal: An edict urged Heng Rui to go to Zhen'an and Wulang to suppress the rebels; in the third month he reached Tangcang.
translations.idiomatic: An edict pressed him to move on Zhen'an and Wulang; in spring he reached Tangcang.

sentences.zh: 楊開甲、高均德方擾南星，留總兵觀祥駐守，自​​赴商州。

translations.literal: Yang Kaijia and Gao Junde were then harassing Nanxing; he left Brigadier Guanxiang to garrison the post and himself went to Shangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Kaijia and Gao Junde were raiding Nanxing; he left Brigadier Guanxiang to hold the line and went on to Shangzhou himself.

sentences.zh: 帝疑其趨避，累詔詰責，乃赴鎮安剿冉文勝等，敗之於大中溪。

translations.literal: The Emperor suspected him of evasion; repeatedly edicts questioned and rebuked him; he then went to Zhen'an to suppress Ran Wensheng and others and defeated them at Dazhongxi.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor suspected him of shying away from the fight and rebuked him repeatedly; he then went to Zhen'an against Ran Wensheng and others and routed them at Dazhongxi.

sentences.zh: 會額勒登保破開甲於輝峪，恆瑞自龍駒寨抄截，開甲逸走，圍副將李天林於漫川關，馳援，斬賊目羅貴等，賊乃分路西竄。

translations.literal: At the same time Eledengbao defeated Kaijia at Huiyu; Heng Rui cut them off from Longjuzhai; Kaijia escaped; [the rebels] besieged Deputy Commander Li Tianlin at Manchuanguan; [Heng Rui] hurried to relieve him, beheaded the rebel officers Luo Gui and others, and the rebels then split and fled west.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Eledengbao beat Kaijia at Huiyu; Heng Rui intercepted from Longjuzhai; Kaijia slipped away but then besieged Deputy Commander Li Tianlin at Manchuanguan; Heng Rui raced to relieve him, killed officers such as Luo Gui, and the rebels scattered westward.

sentences.zh: 敘功，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: His merit was recorded and he was granted the hereditary rank of Cloud Cavalry Captain.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he received the hereditary rank of Cloud Cavalry Captain.

sentences.zh: 六月，率總兵德忠駐守太渠、唐藏。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he led Brigadier Dezhong to garrison Taiqu and Tangcang.
translations.idiomatic: In summer he and Brigadier Dezhong garrisoned Taiqu and Tangcang.

sentences.zh: 時伍金柱、高天德、馬學禮犯西鄉，提督王文雄戰歿，乃進兵大石川，賊奔灘口，為楊遇春所破。

translations.literal: At that time Wu Jinzhu, Gao Tiande, and Ma Xueli invaded Xixiang; Provincial Commander-in-Chief Wang Wenxiong was killed in battle; [Heng Rui] then advanced to Dashichuan; the rebels fled to Tankou and were defeated by Yang Yuchun.
translations.idiomatic: When Wu Jinzhu, Gao Tiande, and Ma Xueli struck Xixiang, Provincial Commander Wang Wenxiong was killed; Heng Rui advanced to Dashichuan; the rebels fled to Tankou and were broken by Yang Yuchun.

sentences.zh: 恆瑞自教匪起，久在行間，以偏師數臨大敵，至是老病，久無顯功。

translations.literal: From the rise of the sectarian rebels Heng Rui had long been in the field; with detached forces he had repeatedly faced great enemies; by now he was old and ill and for a long time had no outstanding achievements.
translations.idiomatic: Since the sectarian uprising Heng Rui had spent years in the field, repeatedly leading smaller forces against major rebel armies; by now he was old and sick and had long ceased to win striking victories.

sentences.zh: 帝慮其不任戰，詢額勒登保，上其狀，命回鎮西安。

translations.literal: The Emperor feared he was no longer fit for battle, inquired of Eledengbao, received his report on the matter, and ordered [Heng Rui] to return and garrison Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing he could no longer bear the strain of campaigning, the emperor asked Eledengbao, who reported on his condition, and ordered him back to his post at Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 逾年卒。

translations.literal: The following year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died the following year.

sentences.zh: 慶成，孫氏，漢軍正白旗人，提督思克曾孫，都統五福孫也。

translations.literal: Qing Cheng, of the Sun clan, was a Han Bannerman of the Plain White Banner, the great-grandson of Provincial Commander Sike, and the grandson of Commander-in-Chief Wufu.
translations.idiomatic: Qing Cheng, of the Sun clan, belonged to the Han Plain White Banner; he was the great-grandson of Provincial Commander Sike and the grandson of Commander-in-Chief Wufu.

sentences.zh: 由鑾儀衛整儀尉，累遷廣東督標副將。

translations.literal: Starting as a ceremonial guard of the Imperial Procession Guard, he was repeatedly promoted to deputy commander of the Guangdong governor's standard brigade.
translations.idiomatic: He began in the Imperial Procession Guard and rose step by step to deputy commander of the Guangdong governor's brigade.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十三年，從總督孫士毅徵安南，屢擒敵有功，賜花翎、錫郎阿巴圖魯勇號。

translations.literal: In the fifty-third year of Qianlong he followed Governor-General Sun Shiyi in the campaign against Annam, repeatedly captured the enemy with merit, and was granted the peacock feather and the brave title Xilangabatulu.
translations.idiomatic: In 1788 he followed Governor-General Sun Shiyi against Annam, took many prisoners in repeated successes, and received the peacock feather and the brave title Xilangabatulu.

sentences.zh: 內擢正白旗漢軍副都統、戶部侍郎、御前侍衛、正紅旗護軍統領。

translations.literal: He was promoted within the capital to Deputy Lieutenant-General of the Han Plain White Banner, Vice Minister of Revenue, Imperial Bodyguard, and Commander of the Garrison of the Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was then promoted in the capital to deputy lieutenant-general of the Han Plain White Banner, vice minister of revenue, imperial bodyguard, and commander of the Plain Red Banner garrison.

sentences.zh: 五十七年，出為古北口提督。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year he went out to serve as provincial commander at Gubeikou.
translations.idiomatic: In 1792 he was appointed provincial commander at Gubeikou.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，率兵赴南陽、襄陽剿教匪，偕恆瑞迭敗姚之富、劉之協於雙溝、張家集。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he led troops to Nanyang and Xiangyang to suppress the sectarian rebels; together with Heng Rui he repeatedly defeated Yao Zhifu and Liu Zhixie at Shuanggou and Zhangjiaji.
translations.idiomatic: In 1796 he led troops to Nanyang and Xiangyang against the rebels; with Heng Rui he repeatedly routed Yao Zhifu and Liu Zhixie at Shuanggou and Zhangjiaji.

sentences.zh: 賊屯棗陽丫兒山，分踞張家垱，連營十餘裡，遮官軍，慶成先進，襲其寨，大破之，擒宋廷貴、陳正五，追敗餘匪於紅土山，擒黃玉貴，加太子少保。

translations.literal: The rebels encamped at Ya'er Mountain in Zaoyang and separately held Zhangjiadang, their camps stretching for more than ten li and blocking the government army; Qing Cheng advanced first, raided their stockade, inflicted a great defeat, captured Song Tinggui and Chen Zhengwu, pursued and defeated the remnant rebels at Hongtushan, captured Huang Yugui, and was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels held Ya'er Mountain in Zaoyang and Zhangjiadang besides, their camps stretching more than ten li across the government line of march; Qing Cheng led the attack, stormed their stockade, won a crushing victory, took Song Tinggui and Chen Zhengwu, ran down the survivors at Hongtushan and captured Huang Yugui, and was made junior guardian of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 之富竄鍾祥，合劉起榮、張富國等眾五六萬，偕永保等冒雨攻克之，晉太子太保。

translations.literal: Zhifu fled to Zhongxiang and joined Liu Qirong, Zhang Fuguo, and others in a force of fifty or sixty thousand; together with Yongbao and others he stormed and took it in the rain, and was promoted to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Zhifu fled to Zhongxiang and gathered fifty or sixty thousand men under Liu Qirong, Zhang Fuguo, and others; with Yongbao and others Qing Cheng took the place in a rainy assault and was promoted to grand guardian of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 賊遁雙溝，擾唐縣滹沱鎮。

translations.literal: The rebels fled to Shuanggou and harassed Hutuo Town in Tang County.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels slipped away to Shuanggou and raided Hutuo Town in Tang County.

sentences.zh: 慶成等以久戰兵疲，不能圍剿，詔嚴斥之。

translations.literal: Qing Cheng and others, because their troops were worn out from long fighting, could not surround and suppress the rebels; an edict sternly rebuked them.
translations.idiomatic: Qing Cheng and his fellows, their troops exhausted by long campaigning, failed to encircle the rebels; the court rebuked them sharply.

sentences.zh: 賊竄棗陽太平鎮，四路合攻，斬數千級，慶成受矛傷，被優賚。

translations.literal: The rebels fled to Taiping Town in Zaoyang; a four-route combined attack beheaded several thousand; Qing Cheng was wounded by a spear and received special rewards.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled to Taiping Town in Zaoyang; a four-pronged assault killed several thousand; Qing Cheng took a spear wound and received exceptional rewards.

sentences.zh: 十一月，賊潛渡滾河北竄，與永保等並被嚴譴，盡奪宮銜、花翎、勇號，易惠齡為總統。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the rebels secretly crossed north of the Gun River to escape; together with Yongbao and others he was severely reprimanded; all court ranks, the peacock feather, and the brave title were stripped; Huiling was substituted as supreme commander.
translations.idiomatic: In winter the rebels slipped north across the Gun; Qing Cheng and Yongbao were sharply censured, stripped of all court ranks, the peacock feather, and his brave title, and Huiling replaced him as supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 尋偕惠齡連破賊於王家城、梓山。

translations.literal: Before long, together with Huiling, he repeatedly defeated the rebels at Wangjiacheng and Zishan.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he and Huiling routed the rebels in succession at Wangjiacheng and Zishan.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，大戰興隆集，斬二千餘級。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year a great battle was fought at Xinglongji and more than two thousand were beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: In early 1797 a major battle at Xinglongji cost the rebels more than two thousand lives.

sentences.zh: 分路追賊，慶成射中賊首劉起榮，擒之，在諸將中戰最力。

translations.literal: Pursuing the rebels by separate routes, Qing Cheng shot the rebel leader Liu Qirong, captured him, and among the generals fought with the greatest exertion.
translations.idiomatic: In the pursuit by separate routes Qing Cheng shot rebel chief Liu Qirong and took him alive; among the commanders he fought the hardest.

sentences.zh: 高宗以慶成為五福孫，不次擢用；

translations.literal: The Gaozong Emperor, because Qing Cheng was Wufu's grandson, had promoted him out of turn;
translations.idiomatic: Because Qing Cheng was Wufu's grandson, the Qianlong Emperor had promoted him ahead of his years;

sentences.zh: 自縱賊滾河，慮其少年自用，不能服眾，命惠齡察奏，至是詔免前罪。

translations.literal: since he had let the rebels escape at the Gun River, [the Emperor] feared that in his youth he was self-willed and could not win the obedience of the troops, and ordered Huiling to investigate and report; on this occasion an edict pardoned his earlier offenses.
translations.idiomatic: after he let the rebels cross the Gun, the emperor feared the young man's self-will and inability to command respect, and ordered Huiling to investigate; now an edict pardoned his earlier faults.

sentences.zh: 二月，擊賊曾家店，胸中矛，裹創而戰。

translations.literal: In the second month he attacked the rebels at Zengjiadian, was struck in the chest by a spear, and fought on with his wounds bound.
translations.idiomatic: In spring he struck the rebels at Zengjiadian, took a spear in the chest, and fought on with his wounds bound up.

sentences.zh: 賊敗竄河南境，分數路，慶成追李全，連破之確山五里川、盧氏火焰溝。

translations.literal: The rebels were defeated and fled into Henan territory, splitting into several routes; Qing Cheng pursued Li Quan and repeatedly defeated him at Wulichuan in Queshan and Huoyangou in Lushi.
translations.idiomatic: The beaten rebels scattered into Henan along several routes; Qing Cheng chased Li Quan and routed him repeatedly at Wulichuan in Queshan and at Huoyangou in Lushi.

sentences.zh: 四月，李全、王廷詔合陷鄖西，馳復其城，賊不戰分遁。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Li Quan and Wang Tingzhao together took Yunxi; [Qing Cheng] hurried to recover the city; the rebels fled without fighting, splitting apart.
translations.idiomatic: In summer Li Quan and Wang Tingzhao together seized Yunxi; Qing Cheng raced to retake the city, and the rebels slipped away without a fight.

sentences.zh: 未幾，之富竄渡漢江，降二品頂戴，​​暫留提督任。

translations.literal: Before long Zhifu fled across the Han River; [Qing Cheng's rank] was reduced to the second-grade cap button, and he was temporarily retained in the post of provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Zhifu broke across the Han; Qing Cheng was reduced to second-grade rank but kept temporarily as provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 襄匪竄開州，偕惠齡追敗之南天峒、火焰壩，复花翎。

translations.literal: The Xiangyang rebels fled into Kaizhou; together with Huiling he pursued and defeated them at Nantiandong and Huoyanba, and regained the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangyang rebels fled into Kaizhou; with Huiling he ran them down at Nantiandong and Huoyanba and won back his peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 賊趨大寧，與川匪合，慶成與川軍會剿。

translations.literal: The rebels turned toward Daning and joined with the Sichuan rebels; Qing Cheng joined the Sichuan army in joint suppression.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels made for Daning and joined the Sichuan rebels; Qing Cheng campaigned with the Sichuan forces.

sentences.zh: 九月，偕恆瑞截擊湖北迴竄之賊於洵陽，而李全、王廷詔沿漢東走，慶成登舟下漢以要其前；

translations.literal: In the ninth month, together with Heng Rui he intercepted at Xunyang the rebels fleeing back from Hubei; while Li Quan and Wang Tingzhao went along the east of the Han, Qing Cheng boarded boats and went down the Han to block them in front;
translations.idiomatic: In autumn he and Heng Rui cut off at Xunyang the rebels doubling back from Hubei; as Li Quan and Wang Tingzhao moved down the east bank of the Han, Qing Cheng took boats downriver to block their path;

sentences.zh: 惠齡、恆瑞從陸躡其後，至紫陽夾攻之，賊竄興安，慶成一晝夜追及，大破之司渡河。

translations.literal: Huiling and Heng Rui followed on land in their rear; reaching Ziyang they attacked from both sides; the rebels fled to Xing'an; Qing Cheng pursued for a day and a night and overtook them, inflicting a great defeat at Sihedu.
translations.idiomatic: Huiling and Heng Rui pressed them overland; at Ziyang they caught the rebels in a pincer; the rebels fled to Xing'an; Qing Cheng chased through a day and a night, overtook them, and crushed them at Sihedu.

sentences.zh: 川匪王三槐擾保寧，羅其清、冉文儔分掠川東，命移兵赴川，與宜綿合剿。

translations.literal: The Sichuan rebel Wang Sanhuai harassed Baoning; Luo Qiqing and Ran Wenchou separately plundered eastern Sichuan; he was ordered to shift his troops to Sichuan and join Yimian in joint suppression.
translations.idiomatic: The Sichuan rebel Wang Sanhuai raided Baoning while Luo Qiqing and Ran Wenchou ravaged eastern Sichuan; he was ordered into Sichuan to campaign with Yimian.

sentences.zh: 三年，截擊其清，腿中槍，創甚，解任回旗就醫。

translations.literal: In the third year he intercepted Qiqing, was shot in the leg, was severely wounded, was relieved of office, and returned to his banner to seek medical treatment.
translations.idiomatic: In 1798 he intercepted Qiqing, took a bullet in the leg, was badly wounded, left his post, and went back to his banner to recover.

sentences.zh: 四年，創愈，仍在御前侍衛行走。

translations.literal: In the fourth year his wounds healed and he again served in attendance as an imperial bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In 1799 his wounds healed and he resumed duty as an imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 尋授成都將軍，命赴陝西與永保協剿張漢潮。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was appointed General at Chengdu and ordered to go to Shaanxi to join Yongbao in suppressing Zhang Hanchao.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was made general at Chengdu and ordered to Shaanxi to join Yongbao against Zhang Hanchao.

sentences.zh: 會明亮訐奏永保、慶成失機，命那彥成、松筠按治，褫職逮問；

translations.literal: At the same time Mingliang memorialized accusing Yongbao and Qing Cheng of missing their opportunities; Nayancheng and Songyun were ordered to investigate, strip them of office, and arrest them for questioning;
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Mingliang accused Yongbao and Qing Cheng of bungling their chances; Nayancheng and Songyun were ordered to investigate, strip their offices, and arrest them for trial;

sentences.zh: 又以在湖北受軍需饋遺，籍其家。

translations.literal: Moreover, because in Hubei he had received gifts related to military supplies, his household property was confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: He was also found to have accepted military-supply gifts in Hubei, and his family estate was confiscated.

sentences.zh: 漢潮既殲，宥罪戍伊犁，未行，五年正月，命仍赴陝軍效力。

translations.literal: After Hanchao had been annihilated, his crime was pardoned and he was banished to garrison Ili; before he set out, in the first month of the fifth year he was ordered to go again and serve in the Shaanxi army.
translations.idiomatic: After Hanchao was destroyed, his sentence was commuted to exile at Ili; before he left, in early 1800 he was ordered back to serve with the Shaanxi forces.

sentences.zh: 額勒登保檄剿高天德、馬學禮，連敗之禮辛鎮、何家衢，擒斬數千，予三等侍衛。

translations.literal: By order of Eledengbao he suppressed Gao Tiande and Ma Xueli, repeatedly defeated them at Lixin Town and Hejiaqu, captured or killed several thousand, and was made a third-rank bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: On Eledengbao's orders he fought Gao Tiande and Ma Xueli, routed them repeatedly at Lixin and Hejiaqu, killed or captured several thousand, and was made a third-rank bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 協剿伍金柱、曾柳，授陝安鎮總兵。

translations.literal: He assisted in suppressing Wu Jinzhu and Zeng Liu, and was appointed brigade commander of Shen'an.
translations.idiomatic: He helped suppress Wu Jinzhu and Zeng Liu and was appointed brigade commander at Shen'an.

sentences.zh: 七月，金柱與冉學勝、張天倫合犯陝，扼之渭河，賊分竄；

translations.literal: In the seventh month Jinzhu joined with Ran Xuesheng and Zhang Tianlun in invading Shaanxi; [Qing Cheng] blocked them at the Wei River, and the rebels split and fled;
translations.idiomatic: In summer Jinzhu joined Ran Xuesheng and Zhang Tianlun in raiding Shaanxi; Qing Cheng held them at the Wei, and the rebels scattered;

sentences.zh: 追天倫於教場壩、麻池溝，殲其黨宋麻子，又敗金柱餘黨曾芝秀於南山：兼署固原提督。

translations.literal: he pursued Tianlun to Jiaochangba and Machigou, annihilated his follower Song Mazi, and again defeated Jinzhu's remnant follower Zeng Zhixiu in the southern mountains: he also served as acting provincial commander at Guyuan.
translations.idiomatic: he chased Tianlun to Jiaochangba and Machigou, destroyed his follower Song Mazi, and beat Jinzhu's remnant Zeng Zhixiu in the southern hills; he also acted as provincial commander at Guyuan.

sentences.zh: 時經略赴川，陝、甘兵三萬餘皆歸慶成節制，川匪冉天元、冉學勝、樊人傑先後渡漢江，詔斥慶成疏防，責戴罪立功。

translations.literal: At that time the grand coordinator went to Sichuan, and more than thirty thousand troops of Shaanxi and Gansu all came under Qing Cheng's command; the Sichuan rebels Ran Tianyuan, Ran Xuesheng, and Fan Renjie crossed the Han River in succession; an edict rebuked Qing Cheng for lax defense and charged him to redeem his guilt through merit.
translations.idiomatic: When the grand coordinator went to Sichuan, more than thirty thousand Shaanxi and Gansu troops fell under Qing Cheng's command; Sichuan rebels Ran Tianyuan, Ran Xuesheng, and Fan Renjie crossed the Han in turn; the court rebuked his lax defense and ordered him to redeem himself in battle.

sentences.zh: 六年，徐天德、樊人傑復至江岸，欲偷渡鄖西，擊卻之，實授提督。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Xu Tiande and Fan Renjie again reached the riverbank and tried to steal a crossing at Yunxi; he drove them back and was formally appointed provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: In 1801 Xu Tiande and Fan Renjie again reached the Han and tried to slip across at Yunxi; he beat them back and received a full appointment as provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 擊楊開甲餘匪於廣元，獲其子麟生，加頭品頂戴。

translations.literal: He attacked Yang Kaijia's remnant rebels at Guangyuan, captured his son Linsheng, and was given the first-grade cap button.
translations.idiomatic: He struck Yang Kaijia's remnants at Guangyuan, captured his son Linsheng, and received the first-grade cap button.

sentences.zh: 苟文明潛入甘肅境，擊走之，复勇號。

translations.literal: Gou Wenming secretly entered Gansu territory; [Qing Cheng] drove him off and regained his brave title.
translations.idiomatic: When Gou Wenming slipped into Gansu, Qing Cheng drove him out and regained his brave title.

sentences.zh: 追川匪辛聰等於寧沔，擒其黨曾顯章、張添潮。

translations.literal: He pursued the Sichuan rebels Xin Cong and others in Ning and Mian, and captured their followers Zeng Xianzhang and Zhang Tianchao.
translations.idiomatic: He chased Sichuan rebels led by Xin Cong through Ning and Mian and captured followers Zeng Xianzhang and Zhang Tianchao.

sentences.zh: 七年，敗張天倫餘黨於鳳縣、兩當，擒張喜、魏洪昇，賊竄紫柏山老林，裹糧入捕，悉殄其眾，复太子太保。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he defeated Zhang Tianlun's remnant followers in Feng County and Liangdang, captured Zhang Xi and Wei Hongsheng; the rebels fled into the deep forests of Zibaishan; carrying provisions he entered to hunt them down and exterminated them all, and was again made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In 1802 he routed Zhang Tianlun's remnants in Feng and Liangdang, took Zhang Xi and Wei Hongsheng, pursued the rebels into the Zibaishan forests with rations for the hunt, wiped them out entirely, and was again made grand guardian of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 先是慶成父歿，軍事方亟，不得去；

translations.literal: Earlier Qing Cheng's father had died, but military affairs were urgent and he could not leave;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier his father had died, but the campaign was urgent and he could not leave;

sentences.zh: 至是南山匪漸少，乃許回旗守制。

translations.literal: by now the rebels in the southern mountains were gradually fewer, and he was permitted to return to his banner to observe mourning.
translations.idiomatic: by now rebels in the southern hills were dwindling, and he was allowed to return home to observe mourning.

sentences.zh: 尋署湖北提督，服闋實授，遷成都將軍。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he served as acting provincial commander in Hubei; when mourning ended he received the full appointment and was transferred to be General at Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he acted as Hubei provincial commander; after mourning he took the post in full and was made general at Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 十一年，入覲，帝睠其勞，問：「曾戴雙眼花翎否？

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he came to audience; the Emperor, mindful of his labors, asked: "Have you ever worn the double-eyed peacock feather?
translations.idiomatic: In 1806 he presented himself at court; mindful of his service, the emperor asked, "Have you ever worn the double-eyed peacock feather?

sentences.zh: 」慶成對：「徵安南蒙賜，和珅禁勿用；

translations.literal: " Qing Cheng replied: "In the Annam campaign I was granted it, but Heshen forbade me to use it;
translations.idiomatic: " Qing Cheng answered, "I received it in the Annam campaign, but Heshen forbade me to wear it;

sentences.zh: 獲劉起榮，先帝欲賜，復為和珅所阻。

translations.literal: when Liu Qirong was captured the late Emperor wished to grant it, but again Heshen obstructed it.
translations.idiomatic: when I took Liu Qirong the late emperor meant to grant it again, but Heshen blocked that too.

sentences.zh: 」命軍機處檢檔無之，遂以欺罔褫職，戍黑龍江。

translations.literal: " The Grand Council was ordered to search the archives and found no record; he was therefore stripped of office for deception and banished to Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: " The Grand Council searched the archives and found no record; he was stripped of office for deceit and exiled to Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 逾年，授圍場總管，歷馬蘭鎮總兵、湖北提督、福州將軍。

translations.literal: The following year he was appointed superintendent of the hunting grounds, and successively served as brigade commander at Malan, provincial commander in Hubei, and general at Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he became superintendent of the imperial hunting grounds, then brigade commander at Malan, Hubei provincial commander, and general at Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 十七年，卒，諡襄恪。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he died, and was given the posthumous title Xiangke.
translations.idiomatic: In 1812 he died and was posthumously titled Xiangke.

sentences.zh: 七十五，瓜爾佳氏，滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Qi Shi Wu, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Shi Wu, of the Guwalgiya clan, belonged to the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中，以護軍從征緬甸，繼赴金川，戰輒力，累遷護軍參領，授貴州大定協副將。

translations.literal: During the Qianlong reign, as a guardsman he followed the campaign against Burma, then went to Jinchuan; in battle he always exerted his strength, was repeatedly promoted to guards company commander, and was appointed deputy commander of the Dadingsie brigade in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianlong he campaigned in Burma as a guardsman, then in Jinchuan, fighting with relentless force; he rose to guards company commander and became deputy commander of the Dadingsie brigade in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 總督福康安薦其才，四十九年，擢宜昌鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Governor-General Fuk'anggan recommended his talent; in the forty-ninth year he was promoted to brigade commander at Yichang.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Fuk'anggan praised his ability, and in 1784 he was made brigade commander at Yichang.

sentences.zh: 父憂去官，坐事降秩，起為健銳營前鋒統領。

translations.literal: He left office for his father's mourning, was demoted for an offense, and was reappointed commander of the vanguard of the Elite Vanguard Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: He left office to mourn his father, was demoted after an offense, and was later made commander of the Elite Vanguard Brigade's vanguard.

sentences.zh: 五十七年，從征廓爾喀，克濟嚨，又克熱索橋，追賊東覺山、雍雅山，攻甲爾古拉，並有功，擢翼長。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year he followed the campaign against Gurkha, took Jilong, again took Resuo Bridge, pursued the enemy at Dongjueshan and Yongyashan, attacked Jiaergula, and in all had merit; he was promoted to wing commander.
translations.idiomatic: In 1792 he fought the Gurkhas, took Jilong and Resuo Bridge, pursued the enemy through Dongjueshan and Yongyashan, stormed Jiaergula, and won promotion to wing commander for his service.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，赴湖北剿教匪，二年四月，追賊入陝，敗之山陽周家河，授西安右翼副都統，兼領健銳營。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he went to Hubei to suppress the sectarian rebels; in the fourth month of the second year he pursued the rebels into Shaanxi and defeated them at Zhoujiahe in Shanyang; he was appointed Right Deputy Lieutenant-General of Xi'an and also commanded the Elite Vanguard Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: In 1796 he went to Hubei against the rebels; in spring 1797 he chased them into Shaanxi and routed them at Zhoujiahe in Shanyang; he became right deputy lieutenant-general of Xi'an and also commanded the Elite Vanguard Brigade.

sentences.zh: 其冬，王三槐回竄四川，追擊於達州崖峰尖，傷右臂；

translations.literal: That winter Wang Sanhuai fled back into Sichuan; [Qi Shi Wu] pursued and attacked at Yafengjian in Dazhou and was wounded in the right arm;
translations.idiomatic: That winter Wang Sanhuai doubled back into Sichuan; Qi Shi Wu pursued him to Yafengjian in Dazhou and was wounded in the right arm;

sentences.zh: 逾日，賊復至，裹創力戰，斬獲甚眾。

translations.literal: the next day the rebels came again; with his wounds bound he fought fiercely and killed or captured very many.
translations.idiomatic: the next day the rebels returned; he fought on with his wounds bound and killed or captured a great many.

sentences.zh: 三年，擢四川提督，敗賊巴州。

translations.literal: In the third year he was promoted to provincial commander of Sichuan and defeated the rebels at Bazhou.
translations.idiomatic: In 1798 he became Sichuan provincial commander and routed the rebels at Bazhou.

sentences.zh: 七月，戰廣木山，克險隘，受傷，被優賚。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he fought at Guangmushan, took the dangerous pass, was wounded, and received special rewards.
translations.idiomatic: In summer he fought at Guangmushan, took the pass, was wounded, and received exceptional rewards.

sentences.zh: 九月，擊冷天祿於木瓜坪，右股中槍，創甚，就夔州療治，四年，始瘳。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he attacked Leng Tianlu at Muguaoping, was shot in the right thigh, was severely wounded, went to Kuizhou for treatment, and only in the fourth year did he recover.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn he struck Leng Tianlu at Muguaoping, took a bullet in the right thigh, was badly wounded, went to Kuizhou to heal, and did not recover until 1799.

sentences.zh: 六月，連破賊於寶塔、蓮花池，扼其入楚之路。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he repeatedly defeated the rebels at Baota and Lianhuachi and blocked their route into Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In summer he repeatedly routed the rebels at Baota and Lianhuachi and blocked their path into Huguang.

sentences.zh: 會卜三聘竄大寧，追敗之。

translations.literal: When Bu Sanpin fled into Daning, [Qi Shi Wu] pursued and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: When Bu Sanpin fled into Daning, he pursued and routed him.

sentences.zh: 八月，擒龔建於開縣火峰寨。

translations.literal: In the eighth month he captured Gong Jian at Huofengzhai in Kai County.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn he captured Gong Jian at Huofengzhai in Kai County.

sentences.zh: 十月，與穆克登布夾擊樊人傑於通江、巴州界上，賊走太平，他賊自湖北迴竄，偕硃射鬥迎擊於雲陽，遂追賊川東。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, together with Mukedengbu, he attacked Fan Renjie in a pincer on the border of Tongjiang and Bazhou; the rebels fled to Taiping; other rebels doubling back from Hubei were met and attacked with Zhu Shedou at Yunyang; he then pursued the rebels through eastern Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In winter he and Mukedengbu caught Fan Renjie in a pincer on the Tongjiang-Bazhou border; the rebels fled to Taiping; other rebels returning from Hubei were met with Zhu Shedou at Yunyang, and he chased the enemy through eastern Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 時賊聚川北，而東路久無軍報，適侍郎廣興疏言七十五駐兵夔州，仁宗疑其逗留，下經略察狀，七十五方以攻麂子坪受重傷，額勒登保為疏辯，得白。

translations.literal: At that time the rebels were massed in northern Sichuan, but on the eastern route there had long been no military reports; just then Vice Minister Guangxing memorialized that Qi Shi Wu was encamped at Kuizhou; the Renzong Emperor suspected him of lingering; the grand coordinator was ordered to investigate; Qi Shi Wu had just received serious wounds attacking Jiziping; Eledengbao memorialized in his defense, and he was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels were massed in northern Sichuan while the eastern front had gone silent; Vice Minister Guangxing reported that Qi Shi Wu was lingering at Kuizhou; the Jiaqing Emperor ordered an inquiry; Qi Shi Wu had in fact been badly wounded storming Jiziping; Eledengbao defended him in a memorial, and he was cleared.

sentences.zh: 五年二月，鮮大川擾螞蝗坪，創發，不能騎，舁至軍前督戰。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fifth year Xian Dachuan harassed Mahuangping; [Qi Shi Wu's] wounds reopened; he could not ride and was carried to the front to direct the battle.
translations.idiomatic: In early 1800 Xian Dachuan raided Mahuangping; Qi Shi Wu's wounds reopened; unable to ride, he was carried to the front to command.

sentences.zh: 冉天元擁眾渡嘉陵江，重慶戒嚴，魁倫檄令回守，病不能軍，遣李紹祖率兵赴川西，自就醫順慶。

translations.literal: Ran Tianyuan led a host across the Jialing River; Chongqing was placed on alert; Kuilun ordered by dispatch that he return to defend; too ill to command the army, he sent Li Shaozu to lead troops to western Sichuan and himself went to Shunqing for medical treatment.
translations.idiomatic: Ran Tianyuan crossed the Jialing with a large force; Chongqing went on alert; Kuilun ordered him back to defend; too ill to command, he sent Li Shaozu west while he went to Shunqing to recover.

sentences.zh: 帝疑其飾辭，詔解任，命松筠、勒保察驗得實，以提督銜留營差遣。

translations.literal: The Emperor suspected he was making excuses; an edict removed him from office; Songyun and Lebao were ordered to investigate and found the facts true; he was retained in camp for assignments with the rank of provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor suspected pretense; he was removed from office; Songyun and Lebao investigated and confirmed his illness; he was kept in camp on provincial-commander rank for special assignments.

sentences.zh: 五月，高天德、馬學禮由陝犯川，折入番地，偕阿哈保夾擊於舊關摩天嶺，克新砦，進圍鐵爐寨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Gao Tiande and Ma Xueli invaded Sichuan from Shaanxi, turned into the tribal lands, and together with Ahabao attacked in a pincer at Motianling of Jiuguan, took Xinzhai, and advanced to besiege Tieluzhai.
translations.idiomatic: In summer Gao Tiande and Ma Xueli entered Sichuan from Shaanxi and turned into tribal country; with Ahabao he caught them at Motianling and took Xinzhai, then besieged Tieluzhai.

sentences.zh: 賊乘雨宵遁，追擊之，賊棄牲畜、仗械，驚竄山谷，由草泥土司地走岷州，又走秦州。

translations.literal: The rebels fled by night in the rain; pursuing them, [the army] found the rebels abandoning livestock and weapons and fleeing in panic through the valleys; they went by way of the Caotu tusi territory to Minzhou and then to Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels slipped away in a rainy night; in pursuit the army found them abandoning livestock and arms in panic through the valleys, fleeing by the Caotu tusi route to Minzhou and then Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 七月，兵經新寧，偵馬驛溝有賊，設伏，敗之，仍授四川提督。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, as the army passed Xining, scouts reported rebels at Mayigou; an ambush was set and they were defeated; he was again appointed provincial commander of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn his column passed Xining; learning of rebels at Mayigou, he laid an ambush and routed them, and was again appointed Sichuan provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 賊勢趨重川境，德楞泰、勒保方進剿，七十五分​​擊之。

translations.literal: Rebel strength pressed into the heart of Sichuan; Delengtai and Lebao were advancing to suppress them, and Qi Shi Wu struck them separately.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel pressure mounted in central Sichuan while Delengtai and Lebao advanced; Qi Shi Wu attacked on a separate front.

sentences.zh: 至冬，諸賊相繼窺漢江，德楞泰議擊之南岸，而以七十五出廣元三家壩攻其西北。

translations.literal: By winter the various rebels in succession eyed the Han River; Delengtai planned to strike them on the south bank while Qi Shi Wu was to go out from Guangyuan by Sanjiaba to attack their northwest.
translations.idiomatic: By winter rebel bands were probing the Han again; Delengtai would hit them on the south bank while Qi Shi Wu was to move from Guangyuan through Sanjiaba against their northwest.

sentences.zh: 七十五不聽調，曰：「兵深入，將逼賊入陝，非計也。

translations.literal: Qi Shi Wu would not obey the order, saying: "If the army goes deep in, it will drive the rebels into Shaanxi; that is not a good plan.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Shi Wu refused the order, saying, "If we push too deep we will only drive the rebels into Shaanxi; that is no plan at all.

sentences.zh: 」帝聞，切責之。

translations.literal: " When the Emperor heard of it, he sharply rebuked him.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor heard and rebuked him sharply.

sentences.zh: 六年正月，率子武隆阿由廣元趨南江，擊張世龍於三台山、後河嶺、北溪河，陣斬世龍，擒其黨趙建功、李大維；

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixth year, leading his son Wulong'a from Guangyuan toward Nanjiang, he attacked Zhang Shilong at Santaishan, Houheling, and Beixihe, killed Shilong in battle, and captured his followers Zhao Jiangong and Li Dawei;
translations.idiomatic: In early 1801, leading his son Wulong'a from Guangyuan toward Nanjiang, he fought Zhang Shilong at Santaishan, Houheling, and Beixihe, killed Shilong in battle, and captured Zhao Jiangong and Li Dawei;

sentences.zh: 又追賊至太平華尖山，擒邱天富、週一洪：被優敘。

translations.literal: he again pursued the rebels to Huajianshan in Taiping and captured Qiu Tianfu and Zhou Yihong: he received special commendation.
translations.idiomatic: he pursued the rebels to Huajianshan in Taiping and captured Qiu Tianfu and Zhou Yihong, earning special commendation.

sentences.zh: 三月，攻竹園坪。

translations.literal: In the third month he attacked Zhuyuanping.
translations.idiomatic: In spring he attacked Zhuyuanping.

sentences.zh: 五月，賊分竄陝、楚，七十五追冉天士至平利大渝河，間道據後山，偪其出隘，伏起邀擊，擒斬二千餘，特詔嘉賚。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the rebels split and fled into Shaanxi and Huguang; Qi Shi Wu pursued Ran Tianshi to Dayuhe in Pingli, took a bypath to hold the rear mountain, forced them out of the pass, rose from ambush to intercept them, and captured or killed more than two thousand; a special edict praised and rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: In summer the rebels scattered into Shaanxi and Huguang; Qi Shi Wu chased Ran Tianshi to Dayuhe in Pingli, seized the rear heights by a side path, forced them from the pass, sprang an ambush, and killed or captured more than two thousand; a special edict praised him.

sentences.zh: 乘勝追賊入湖北境，六月，破湯思蛟、劉朝選於羊耳河；

translations.literal: Pressing the victory, he pursued the rebels into Hubei territory; in the sixth month he defeated Tang Sijiao and Liu Chaoxuan at Yang'erhe;
translations.idiomatic: Pressing his advantage into Hubei, in summer he routed Tang Sijiao and Liu Chaoxuan at Yang'erhe;

sentences.zh: 又敗之於保康，殲賊首王鎮賢，遂與德楞泰追龍紹週入川。

translations.literal: he again defeated them at Baokang, annihilated the rebel leader Wang Zhenxian, and then with Delengtai pursued Long Shaozhou into Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: then beat them again at Baokang, destroyed rebel chief Wang Zhenxian, and with Delengtai chased Long Shaozhou into Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 七月，偕李紹祖敗樊人傑於鄰水，追至開縣，复遇思蛟、朝選，連敗之於馬家亭、桑樹坪，由通城進剿苟文懷，擒之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, together with Li Shaozu, he defeated Fan Renjie at Linshui, pursued to Kai County, again met Sijiao and Chaoxuan, repeatedly defeated them at Majiating and Sangshuping, advanced from Tongcheng to suppress Gou Wenhuai, and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn he and Li Shaozu routed Fan Renjie at Linshui and pursued to Kai; meeting Sijiao and Chaoxuan again, he beat them at Majiating and Sangshuping, advanced from Tongcheng against Gou Wenhuai, and took him.

sentences.zh: 餘賊與苟文明合，將竄陝，八月，擊之於大寧山，殲擒及半，文明僅身免，俘其家屬。

translations.literal: The remnant rebels joined with Gou Wenming and were about to flee into Shaanxi; in the eighth month he attacked them at Daningshan, killed or captured about half; Wenming alone escaped, and his family members were captured.
translations.idiomatic: Remnants joined Gou Wenming and were heading for Shaanxi; in autumn he struck them at Daningshan, killing or capturing half; Wenming alone escaped, and his family was taken.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，留防川北，敗賊於南江；

translations.literal: That winter he remained to defend northern Sichuan and defeated the rebels at Nanjiang;
translations.idiomatic: That winter he garrisoned northern Sichuan and routed the rebels at Nanjiang;

sentences.zh: 又與德楞泰合擊於廣元、蒼溪，進搜老林，賊多散匿，百十為群，時有斬獲。

translations.literal: he again joined Delengtai in combined attacks at Guangyuan and Cangxi, advanced to search the deep forests; many rebels scattered and hid in groups of a hundred or ten, and from time to time there were killings and captures.
translations.idiomatic: he joined Delengtai in attacks at Guangyuan and Cangxi and swept the deep forests; rebels scattered in bands of dozens or hundreds, with kills and captures from time to time.

sentences.zh: 十二月，苟文明糾各路餘匪二千餘人，乘間西奔。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Gou Wenming gathered more than two thousand remnant rebels from various routes and, seizing an opportunity, fled west.
translations.idiomatic: At year's end Gou Wenming rallied more than two thousand remnant rebels and slipped west when he saw his chance.

sentences.zh: 七十五與勒保不和，追賊入山，餉半載不至，兵飢疲，就糧太平，六日，賊已渡嘉陵江上游，直趨階州，亟偕慶成馳擊。

translations.literal: Qi Shi Wu was on bad terms with Lebao; pursuing the rebels into the mountains, provisions did not arrive for half a year; the troops were hungry and weary; he went to Taiping for grain; on the sixth day the rebels had already crossed the upper Jialing and rushed straight toward Jiezhou; he urgently joined Qing Cheng in a rapid attack.
translations.idiomatic: On bad terms with Lebao, Qi Shi Wu chased the rebels into the hills; for half a year no supplies came and his men starved; he went to Taiping for grain; on the sixth day the rebels had crossed the upper Jialing and were racing for Jiezhou; he hurried with Qing Cheng to intercept them.

sentences.zh: 額勒登保、德楞泰先後劾其頓兵縱寇，未幾，賊復自廣元渡江入甘肅，帝益怒，嚴詔褫職逮問。

translations.literal: Eledengbao and Delengtai successively impeached him for halting his troops and letting the rebels escape; before long the rebels again crossed the river from Guangyuan into Gansu; the Emperor grew still angrier and by stern edict stripped him of office and ordered his arrest for questioning.
translations.idiomatic: Eledengbao and Delengtai impeached him for stalling and letting the rebels escape; soon the rebels crossed again from Guangyuan into Gansu; the emperor's anger deepened, and a stern edict stripped him of office and ordered his arrest.

sentences.zh: 七十五故宿將，勇而訥，臨陣輒死鬥，身被重創十五次。

translations.literal: Qi Shi Wu was an old veteran, brave but taciturn; in battle he always fought to the death and had received serious wounds fifteen times.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Shi Wu was an old veteran, brave and taciturn; in battle he always fought as if ready to die, and had been seriously wounded fifteen times.

sentences.zh: 將弁畏其苦戰，不樂相隨。

translations.literal: Officers and men feared his bitter fighting and were unwilling to follow him.
translations.idiomatic: His officers dreaded his relentless style of combat and were reluctant to follow him.

sentences.zh: 自領偏師當艱險，數以軍報後時遭譴；

translations.literal: He himself led detached forces against the hardest dangers and several times was rebuked because his military reports arrived late;
translations.idiomatic: He often led detached forces into the worst ground and was repeatedly censured for late reports;

sentences.zh: 至是，复失機就逮，一軍皆慟哭。

translations.literal: on this occasion he again missed his opportunity and was arrested; the whole army wept.
translations.idiomatic: now he missed his chance again and was arrested, and the whole army wept.

sentences.zh: 額勒登保等為疏陳戰狀，乞恩，許留營自贖。

translations.literal: Eledengbao and others memorialized describing his battle record and begged for grace; he was permitted to remain in camp to redeem himself.
translations.idiomatic: Eledengbao and others described his fighting in memorials and begged mercy; he was allowed to remain in camp to redeem himself.

sentences.zh: 七年，剿張長庚、陳自得殘匪於夔州，留防川東。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he suppressed the remnant bandits Zhang Changgeng and Chen Zide at Kuizhou and remained to defend eastern Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In 1802 he cleared remnant bands led by Zhang Changgeng and Chen Zide at Kuizhou and stayed to guard eastern Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 舊創發，予護軍校，還京。

translations.literal: His old wounds reopened; he was given the rank of guards corporal and returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: His old wounds reopened; he was made a guards corporal and sent back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 逾年，卒，贈副都統銜，賜卹如例。

translations.literal: The following year he died; he was posthumously given the rank of deputy lieutenant-general and funeral gifts according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he died; he was posthumously given deputy lieutenant-general rank and regulation funeral honors.

sentences.zh: 子武隆阿，自有傳。

translations.literal: His son Wulong'a has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: His son Wulong'a has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 富志那，赫舍哩氏，滿洲正紅旗人。

translations.literal: Fu Zhina, of the Heseri clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Zhina, of the Heseri clan, belonged to the Manchu Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 起健銳營前鋒，從征葉爾羌、緬甸、金川，授副前鋒參領，出為湖南永綏協副將。

translations.literal: He began in the vanguard of the Elite Vanguard Brigade, followed campaigns in Yarkand, Burma, and Jinchuan, was appointed deputy vanguard company commander, and went out to serve as deputy commander of the Yongshuisie brigade in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: He began in the Elite Vanguard Brigade, campaigned in Yarkand, Burma, and Jinchuan, became deputy vanguard company commander, and was posted as deputy commander of the Yongshuisie brigade in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆六十年，苗叛，駐守永綏。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year of Qianlong the Miao rebelled, and he garrisoned Yongshui.
translations.idiomatic: In 1795, when the Miao rebelled, he garrisoned Yongshui.

sentences.zh: 苗踞張坪、亞保阻糧運，悉眾來犯，富志那擊卻之。

translations.literal: The Miao held Zhangping and Yabao and blocked grain transport; they came with all their forces to attack, and Fu Zhina drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: The Miao held Zhangping and Yabao and blocked supply lines; they attacked in full force, and Fu Zhina beat them back.

sentences.zh: 追至獅子山，诇知有伏，預為戒備，夾攻，多所斬獲。

translations.literal: Pursuing to Shizishan, he learned through reconnaissance that there was an ambush, made preparations in advance, attacked from both sides, and killed or captured many.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing to Shizishan, his scouts found an ambush waiting; he prepared in advance, struck from both sides, and killed or captured many.

sentences.zh: 越日，苗復以數千人撲營，殊死戰，簡精銳迎擊，大敗之，賜花翎。

translations.literal: The next day the Miao again rushed the camp with several thousand men; in desperate fighting he selected elite troops to meet the attack and inflicted a great defeat; he was granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: The next day several thousand Miao stormed the camp; in desperate fighting he sent picked troops to meet them, won a crushing victory, and received the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 永綏被圍久，糧芻且盡，居民隨官軍晝夜登陴，城賴以固。

translations.literal: Yongshui had long been besieged and grain and fodder were nearly exhausted; the inhabitants, together with the government army, mounted the walls day and night, and the city was thereby held firm.
translations.idiomatic: Yongshui had been besieged so long that supplies were nearly gone; townspeople and soldiers manned the walls day and night, and the city held.

sentences.zh: 大軍至，圍乃解。

translations.literal: When the main army arrived, the siege was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: When the main army arrived, the siege was raised.

sentences.zh: 從福康安克高多寨，吳半生就擒。

translations.literal: Following Fuk'anggan he took Gaoduo Stockade, and Wu Bansheng was captured.
translations.idiomatic: With Fuk'anggan he took Gaoduo Stockade and captured Wu Bansheng.

sentences.zh: 福康安薦其老成明幹，苗民感畏，擢總兵。

translations.literal: Fuk'anggan recommended him as steady, experienced, and capable; the Miao were moved to fear and respect him, and he was promoted to brigade commander.
translations.idiomatic: Fuk'anggan praised his steady competence; the Miao came to fear and respect him, and he was promoted to brigade commander.

sentences.zh: 迭攻高斗山、擒頭坡、吉吉寨，皆捷，賜蟒衣一襲。

translations.literal: In succession he attacked Gaodoushan, Qintoupo, and Jijizhai, all with victory, and was granted one python robe.
translations.idiomatic: In succession he took Gaodoushan, Qintoupo, and Jijizhai, winning each time, and received a python robe.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，湖北教匪聶傑人、張正謨於枝江、宜都倡亂，巡撫惠齡駐軍太和山，富志那馳赴之，進擊鳳凰山，擒傑人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing the Hubei sectarian rebels Nie Jieren and Zhang Zhengmo raised rebellion at Zhijiang and Yidu; Governor Huiling encamped at Taihe Mountain; Fu Zhina hurried there, advanced to attack Fenghuang Mountain, and captured Jieren.
translations.idiomatic: In 1796 the Hubei rebels Nie Jieren and Zhang Zhengmo rose at Zhijiang and Yidu; Governor Huiling held Taihe Mountain; Fu Zhina rushed there, stormed Fenghuang Mountain, and captured Jieren.

sentences.zh: 餘賊乘雨撲營，擊卻之，又敗之於楊白堰。

translations.literal: The remnant rebels took advantage of the rain to rush the camp; he drove them back and again defeated them at Yangbaiyan.
translations.idiomatic: Remnants used the rain to storm the camp; he beat them off and routed them again at Yangbaiyan.

sentences.zh: 正謨踞灌灣腦，四面環山，富志那自蔡家坡進，冒雨奪卡，而伏隊於深箐，賊至，左右夾擊，多墜岩澗死；

translations.literal: Zhengmo held Guanwannao, surrounded by mountains on all sides; Fu Zhina advanced from Caijiapo, stormed the stockade in the rain, while ambush troops lay in the deep ravines; when the rebels arrived, he attacked from left and right; many fell from cliffs and gullies to their deaths;
translations.idiomatic: Zhengmo held Guanwannao in a ring of mountains; Fu Zhina advanced from Caijiapo, took the stockade in the rain, and hid troops in the ravines; when the rebels came he struck from both sides and many fell to their deaths in the cliffs;

sentences.zh: 山前設疑兵，別由徑道深入，出不意擊之，大捷：賜號法福禮巴圖魯。

translations.literal: he set decoy troops before the mountain and separately went deep by a path, struck them unexpectedly, and won a great victory: he was granted the title Fafolibaturu.
translations.idiomatic: he posted decoys before the mountain, then struck unexpectedly along a hidden path and won a great victory, receiving the title Fafolibaturu.

sentences.zh: 迭克雞公山、王母峒，進攻筲箕垱，正謨勢蹙，四出求救，富志那與副都統成德分路設伏，偽樹白幟為援兵，誘賊出，大破之，遂克筲箕垱；

translations.literal: In succession he took Jigongshan and Wangmudong, advanced to attack Shaojidang; Zhengmo's situation was pressed; he sent out in all directions for rescue; Fu Zhina and Deputy Lieutenant-General Chengde set ambushes by separate routes, falsely raised white banners as relief troops, lured the rebels out, inflicted a great defeat, and then took Shaojidang;
translations.idiomatic: He took Jigongshan and Wangmudong in turn and attacked Shaojidang; Zhengmo, hard pressed, sent for help in all directions; Fu Zhina and Deputy Lieutenant-General Chengde laid ambushes on separate routes, hoisted white banners as fake reinforcements, drew the rebels out, crushed them, and took Shaojidang;

sentences.zh: 乘勝取灌灣腦，擒正謨。

translations.literal: Pressing the victory, he took Guanwannao and captured Zhengmo.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing his victory, he took Guanwannao and captured Zhengmo.

sentences.zh: 枝江、宜都悉平。

translations.literal: Zhijiang and Yidu were entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Zhijiang and Yidu were fully pacified.

sentences.zh: 命回苗疆治善後。

translations.literal: He was ordered to return to the Miao frontier to handle postwar affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered back to the Miao frontier to handle reconstruction.

sentences.zh: 二年，議闢永綏北路，留兵二萬分防黔、楚，授富志那為總兵，駐鎮筸，與提督分領其軍。

translations.literal: In the second year it was decided to open the northern route of Yongshui; twenty thousand troops were left to defend Guizhou and Huguang separately; Fu Zhina was appointed brigade commander, garrisoned at Zhenqian, and shared command of the army with the provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: In 1797 the northern Yongshui route was opened; twenty thousand troops were left to guard Guizhou and Huguang; Fu Zhina was made brigade commander at Zhenqian and shared command with the provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 苗疆自同知傅鼐築碉屯田，邊備漸嚴，而苗未遽服，構眾抗阻，大吏諉過於鼐，將劾之，富志那力爭乃止。

translations.literal: Since Subprefect Fu Nai had built forts and opened garrison farms in the Miao frontier, border defenses gradually grew strict, but the Miao had not quickly submitted; they gathered crowds to resist; high officials blamed Fu Nai and were about to impeach him; Fu Zhina argued forcefully and it was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Since Subprefect Fu Nai had built forts and opened garrison farms on the Miao frontier, defenses tightened, but the Miao had not yet submitted and gathered to resist; senior officials blamed Fu Nai and were about to impeach him; Fu Zhina argued hard and stopped it.

sentences.zh: 移軍需助其建設，後屯田利興，苗患遂息。

translations.literal: He shifted military supplies to assist the construction; afterward the garrison farms prospered and Miao troubles ceased.
translations.idiomatic: He diverted military supplies to help the work; the garrison farms later prospered and Miao unrest subsided.

sentences.zh: 人稱鼐功，兼頌富志那不置雲。

translations.literal: People praised Fu Nai's achievement and also extolled Fu Zhina without end.
translations.idiomatic: People praised Fu Nai's work and endlessly celebrated Fu Zhina as well.

sentences.zh: 五年，鎮筸曬金塘黑苗出掠，與鼐並力禦擊；

translations.literal: In the fifth year, at Zhenqian, black Miao from Shaijintang came out to raid; together with Fu Nai he resisted and attacked;
translations.idiomatic: In 1800 black Miao from Shaijintang raided from Zhenqian; with Fu Nai he drove them back;

sentences.zh: 又要擊苗黨於狗嵒，焚其寨，苗懼，乞降。

translations.literal: he again attacked Miao bands at Gouyan, burned their stockade, the Miao were afraid, and begged to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: he again struck Miao bands at Gouyan, burned their stockade, and the Miao, frightened, sued for peace.

sentences.zh: 八年，永綏苗龍六生擾動，擒之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the Yongshui Miao Long Liusheng stirred up trouble and was captured.
translations.idiomatic: In 1803 the Yongshui Miao leader Long Liusheng rose in revolt and was captured.

sentences.zh: 署湖南提督，調授貴州提督，軍政肅然，時稱名將。

translations.literal: He served as acting provincial commander in Hunan, was transferred and appointed provincial commander in Guizhou; military and civil administration were orderly, and at the time he was called a famous general.
translations.idiomatic: He acted as Hunan provincial commander, then was appointed Guizhou provincial commander; discipline was strict and he was acclaimed as a famous general.

sentences.zh: 十五年，卒於官。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he died in office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1810 he died in office.

sentences.zh: 亮祿，伊爾根覺羅氏，滿洲正紅旗人。

translations.literal: Liang Lu, of the Irgen Gioro clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Lu, of the Irgen Gioro clan, belonged to the Manchu Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 襲輕車都尉世職，授密雲協領。

translations.literal: He inherited the hereditary office of Commandant of Light Chariots and was appointed company commander of the Miyun brigade.
translations.idiomatic: He inherited the hereditary rank of commandant of light chariots and was appointed company commander of the Miyun brigade.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶初，以參將發河南，署游擊。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jiaqing he was dispatched to Henan as a colonel and served as acting brigade commander.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Jiaqing reign he was sent to Henan as a colonel and acted as brigade commander.

sentences.zh: 三年，教匪窺河南，巡撫吳熊光駐防盧氏，兵多他調。

translations.literal: In the third year the sectarian rebels eyed Henan; Governor Wu Xiongguang garrisoned Lushi, but many troops had been transferred elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: In 1798 the rebels probed Henan; Governor Wu Xiongguang held Lushi, but most of his troops had been sent elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 寶豐、郟縣賊起，掠汝州。

translations.literal: Rebels rose in Baofeng and Jia County and plundered Ruzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels rose in Baofeng and Jia and raided Ruzhou.

sentences.zh: 布政使馬慧裕不嫺軍事，亮祿曰：「兵貴神速。

translations.literal: Provincial Treasurer Ma Huiyu was not skilled in military affairs; Liang Lu said: "In warfare speed is precious.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial Treasurer Ma Huiyu knew little of war; Liang Lu said, "Speed is everything in war.

sentences.zh: 今賊初起，烏合易滅，請兼程往剿。

translations.literal: Now the rebels have just risen and, as a mob gathered in haste, are easy to destroy; I request to go by forced marches to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: They have only just risen, a mob that can easily be broken; let me go at once by forced marches to destroy them.

sentences.zh: 」賊屯寶豐翟家集，東阻大溝，恃險不退，亮祿聲言京兵且至，樹八旗大纛，鞭馬腹，俾騰踔嘶號，聲震數里，賊懼；

translations.literal: " The rebels encamped at Zhijiaji in Baofeng, blocked on the east by a great ditch, relied on the dangerous ground and would not retreat; Liang Lu spread word that capital troops were about to arrive, raised the great banners of the Eight Banners, whipped the horses' bellies to make them leap and neigh, and the sound shook the ground for several li; the rebels were afraid;
translations.idiomatic: " The rebels held Zhijiaji in Baofeng behind a great ditch to the east and would not budge; Liang Lu spread word that capital troops were coming, raised the Eight Banners' great standards, whipped his horses until they leapt and neighed, and the din carried for miles; the rebels were terrified;

sentences.zh: 夜吹角而進，躍馬逾壕，火其寨，一鼓殲之，擒其渠李岳等。

translations.literal: at night he sounded the horn and advanced, leaped his horse over the moat, set fire to their stockade, destroyed them in a single assault, and captured their leaders Li Yue and others.
translations.idiomatic: That night he sounded the horn, charged over the ditch, burned their camp, wiped them out in one assault, and captured leaders such as Li Yue.

sentences.zh: 奏入，仁宗大悅，立擢副將。

translations.literal: When the memorial arrived, the Renzong Emperor was greatly pleased and immediately promoted him to deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: When the report reached court, the Jiaqing Emperor was delighted and immediately promoted him to deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 累遷雲南開化鎮總兵。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to brigade commander at Kaihua in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: He rose step by step to brigade commander at Kaihua in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 七年，卒，帝甚惜之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he died, and the Emperor deeply regretted it.
translations.idiomatic: In 1802 he died, to the emperor's deep regret.

sentences.zh: 論曰：恆瑞、慶成戮力襄陽，剿匪最久，後皆獨當一面，功過不掩，故仁宗始終保全。

translations.literal: The commentator says: Heng Rui and Qing Cheng exerted their strength together at Xiangyang and suppressed the rebels the longest; afterward each commanded a separate front; their merits and faults did not cancel each other out, and therefore the Renzong Emperor preserved them to the end.
translations.idiomatic: The historian comments: Heng Rui and Qing Cheng fought side by side at Xiangyang longer than any others against the rebels; each later held an independent command; their merits and faults stood side by side, and so the Jiaqing Emperor protected them to the end.

sentences.zh: 七十五孤軍苦戰，徒以失懽群帥，未奏顯功，論者惜之。

translations.literal: Qi Shi Wu fought bitterly with isolated forces, but only because he lost the favor of the commanders as a group did he fail to achieve outstanding merit; commentators regret it.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Shi Wu fought bitterly with isolated forces, but because he lost favor with his fellow commanders he never won striking glory; historians regret it.

sentences.zh: 富志那獨平枝江、宜都一路，移鎮苗疆，與傅鼐和衷弭亂，有足稱焉。

translations.literal: Fu Zhina alone pacified the route of Zhijiang and Yidu, was transferred to garrison the Miao frontier, worked in harmony with Fu Nai to quell disorder, and is worthy of praise.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Zhina alone pacified the Zhijiang-Yidu corridor, then garrisoned the Miao frontier and, working in harmony with Fu Nai, quelled unrest there—achievements well worth praise.
